name: AGC-003 — Credential-Harvesting Link Click
description: Disclosure: Executed & documented by Claude Code under direction and review by Hasan. | AGC-003: Victim clicks phishing link and submits AD credentials into fake login portal on attacker server. Credentials captured. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.

techniques.comment: AGC-003: Credential-harvesting phishing. Email lure from helpdesk@ashfordgrove.local with link to http://10.10.40.10/portal-login. Victim submitted AD credentials (michael.chen@ashfordgrove.local) via POST to /login. Server confirmed capture: 'Sign-in received. Redirecting...' Sysmon EID 1 process create, EID 3 network connection to 10.10.40.10:80. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: Critical.
